audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 8.5/10 and 'Hard matchup' framing contradict a 51.25% Emerald+ win rate over 999 games.
audit.why: Gangplank is above 50% here; the lane is skill-dependent early and GP-favoured once Sheen lands, not hard.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 5/10, Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10; early is his, first item onward is yours.
sources: kit: Mordekaiser has no dash or gap-closer

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart had Mordekaiser winning levels 1, 6-item and 2-item stages, contradicting the packet chart and the whys text, which say level 1 is even and the item stages are Gangplank's.
audit.why: whys[0] states the level-1 trade cancels out; whys[5]/whys[6] state Sheen and 2 items flip the lane to Gangplank. The packet levelChart agrees. Only the full/content sides were stale.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as an atomic group: Level 1 = Skill 5/10, First item = Gangplank 7/10, 2+ items = Gangplank 8/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names — Mordekaiser's E called 'Death Grip' (really Death's Grasp) and his Q called 'Mace of Spades' (really Obliterate). Text also claims Remove Scurvy cleanses the E pull.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon names E Death's Grasp (700 range, 16/14/12/10/8) and Q Obliterate (675, 8/7/6/5/4). A displacement pull is not a cleansable crowd-control effect in the way the text asserts, and Riot's E text mentions no root at all, so the cleanse claim is unsupported.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout; W repositioned as the post-drag heal/burst answer rather than an unverified pull cleanse. Anti-heal called out against Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8) shield-into-heal sustain.

audit.why: Realm of Death at 140/120/100 is the punishable cooldown and the text already tracks it; real number added for concreteness.
Oblivion Orb / Executioner's is already listed early, which is exactly what the missing-interaction rule asks for against Indestructible.

edits.before: Morde's W shield and isolated-target Q (Mace of Spades) come online before your second keg, so his short auto-Q trade beats your bare Parrrley poke and out-sustains it.
edits.after: Morde's Indestructible shield and single-target Obliterate (Q, 8s at rank 1) land before your second keg, so his auto-Q trade beats bare Parrrley poke and out-sustains it.

edits.before: Realm of Death (R) isolates you into a 1v1 box where your global Cannon Barrage and barrel zoning are useless, and the percentage of your stats he steals wins the duel.
edits.after: Realm of Death (R, 140s at rank 1) isolates you where your global Cannon Barrage and barrel zoning are useless, and the stats he steals win the duel — bait it, then fight.

edits.before: Sheen into the upgraded keg build: a Sheen-empowered Parrrley detonating a barrel chain finally out-bursts his W-shield sustain from outside his E (Death Grip) range.
edits.after: Sheen into the upgraded keg build: a Sheen-empowered Parrrley detonating a barrel chain out-bursts his Indestructible shield from outside his E (Death's Grasp) 700 range.

edits.before: Land E (Death Grip) to pull and root you, then slam an isolated Q for the bonus-damage trade
edits.after: Land E (Death's Grasp, 16s) to drag you in, then slam an isolated Obliterate for the bonus damage

edits.before: Hold Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse his E pull/root so he can never set up an isolated Q on you
edits.after: Hold Remove Scurvy (W) for the heal after his E (Death's Grasp) drag, not to dodge the pull itself

edits.before: Levels 4-5 I stabilize once I have a second keg and can Parrrley-into-keg poke him as he walks up to farm, so this stretch reads roughly even. But level 6 is his window, not mine: Realm of Death (R) yanks me into a box where my Cannon Barrage and barrel zoning mean nothing and the chunk of my stats he steals wins the straight duel. Bait his E early, then respect his realm range until my first item lands. Never burn W before his E pull, because cleansing it is what saves the all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 I stabilize once I have a second keg and can Parrrley-into-keg poke him as he walks up to farm, so this stretch reads roughly even. But level 6 is his window, not mine: Realm of Death (R, 140s) yanks me into a box where my Cannon Barrage and barrel zoning mean nothing and the stats he steals win the straight duel. Bait his E (16s at rank 1), then hold outside his 650 realm range until my first item lands. I save W for the burst after the drag, never before it.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: barrel chains plus max Parrrley kill him from range and he has no dash to close it. Carry threat 7/10 — end it.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Realm of Death and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Realm of Death's 140s and how disciplined your kegs are.

edits.before: Carry threat: 8.5/10. If Mordekaiser gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 7/10. If Mordekaiser gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — build your teamfight around that. Mordekaiser carry threat: 8.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — build your teamfight around that. Mordekaiser carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal beats Indestructible, so buy Oblivion Orb before his 2-item window.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Mordekaiser carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Playable at 51% — difficulty 5/10, Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Death's Grasp drags you off it and he pops the keg for free on the way in.

notes: Two fabricated names corrected (Death Grip -> Death's Grasp, Mace of Spades -> Obliterate). The claim that Remove Scurvy cleanses Mordekaiser's E pull is unverified in Riot's text (no root mentioned) so I rewrote around it rather than asserting either way. Level chart flipped as one atomic group to match the packet chart and the existing whys prose.
